name: coutreach-funders
description: Ruling 57 (Doug, 10-20-26): a campaign names its funders, like its partners (CM-2's twin). One many-to-many link from COutreachCampaign to CSponsorProfile; its reverse feeds the funder record's Campaigns tab (CM-5's twin). COutreachCampaign.sponsorProfiles is taken (the ruling-27 attribution reverse), so the campaign side is funderProfiles.
